selection_policy: Curated writing-analysis corpus, not an objective top-35 ranking. Core: mature main-conference papers from 2013 onward (selected papers 2014–2020), informed by official Test of Time recognition, persistent citation/use, topic and contribution diversity; recent official 2026 Outstanding papers separately calibrate current writing. All counted works have actual full main-text narrative reading; scope and source-version limits are explicit. See selection-audit.md.
